csv_project_name: Design for Tibbetts Valley Park Electric Vehicle Charging
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Issaquah (City) seeks to secure the services of a consulting firm with expertise in electric vehicle charging engineering design. The City of Issaquah received grant funding to install public electric vehicle (EV) charging stations at Tibbetts Valley Park, located at 1600 Newport Way, Issaquah, in the west parking lot near the Skate Park. This project includes installation of 4 dual port chargers (preferred; alternative of 8 single port chargers acceptable) including electric vehicle only parking signs, conduits, conductors, junction boxes, and connection to existing electrical service switchboard. The EV chargers will most likely be manufactured by ChargePoint and will be capable of managing and monitored through the software provided by ChargePoint. The new EV charging stations will be similar to existing ChargePoint brand CT 4000 series chargers installed at the City s Community Center.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering
